messages:
emily: @here AcmeHealth request — they want Sparrow-3B-v1 onboarded to Private (VPC + dedicated). Target: int8 quant, p50 < 120ms, ~10 qps per replica, HIPAA. Can we triage?

nav: Is this high priority vs other enterprise onboardings? Do we have a requested go-live date?

sarah: They're on Private and asked for a pilot. Hi @devon can you share the target date and sample workloads? :eyes:

devon: Prefer EOW but can stretch. Pilot kickoff in ~3 weeks. Main risk: hallucination on medical QA; they want conservative rollout.

maya: For risk gating we'll run MedQA (exact match + F1), instruction-following eval, and toxicity checks. Need baseline numbers from our MedEval suite.

jordan: Infra note — for p50 ~120ms on a 3B with int8 we'd probably need 1xA10G or equivalent; T4 might be tight. Will profile. Also need autoscale policy and burst capacity set.

emily: Proposed bring-up plan: 1) smoke bring-up in FP16 + unit tests, 2) PTQ int8 profile (calibration on representative prompts), 3) run eval battery (MedQA, instruct, regressions), 4) A/B vs current prod baseline, 5) gated canary rollout. Owner: emily + jordan.

quant-bot: quant-bot: PTQ job template created: job_id=q-1748123456-01. Use config: `bits=8, calibration_size=2k, ops_to_quantize=all`.

emily: Example PTQ command for infra team:
```
redwood-quant run --model sparrow-3b-v1 --mode ptq --calib /data/acme_prompts.json --out /tmp/sparrow3b_int8
```

nav: Add rollback/gating criteria. I suggest: fail if >2% absolute drop in MedQA exact match or >5% increase in toxicity score, or >10ms p50 degradation vs baseline.

maya: Also capture token-level perplexity and generation length distributions. We'll need the customer prompt set (sensitive) — will handle secure transfer.

sarah: I'll request sample prompts and acceptance criteria from AcmeHealth and confirm DPA/KMS requirements.

jordan: Infra estimate: smoke (2h), PTQ sweeps (6-8h depending on calibration), evals (3-4h). I'll reserve a dev pool slot and tag capacity in the boarding ticket.

emily: Question: do we accept PTQ-only for first pass? If we see instruction-following regressions we may need QAT or calibration adjustments.

devon: Pilot OK with PTQ if metrics pass. If not, we'll discuss QAT.

emily: OK. I'll open a boarding PR with the checklist and assign tasks (smoke owner=jordan, ptq owner=emily, evals owner=maya, infra=jordan, customer liaison=sarah). Check-in in 48h. /cc @nav @jordan @maya @sarah

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reserved 1xA10G slot (id=slot-719) for initial smoke window.

emily: Thanks all — logging action items in the boarding PR.
